def factor_vwap_sma_divergence(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    window = 20
    vp = df_copy["close"] * df_copy["volume"]
    vwap = vp.rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum() / df_copy["volume"].rolling(window, min_periods=window).sum()
    sma = df_copy["close"].rolling(window, min_periods=window).mean()
    factor = (vwap - sma) / sma.replace(0, np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_vwap_sma_divergence"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_vwap_sma_divergence"]
description: Computes the percentage difference between 20-day volume-weighted average price (VWAP) and simple moving average (SMA). A positive divergence suggests that upward price moves occur on higher volume, indicating bullish volume-price coherence. A negative divergence implies bearish coherence. This mechanism aligns with the Price-Volume Dynamics layer by integrating volume directly into the price trend signal.
